description: Measure a project with codometer and write its report. Batched, so one process measures every project Nx hands it.

check.description: Fail the task when a limit the project declares is breached, after the report is written.

config.description: The codometer configuration file, relative to the project root.

onlyInputs.description: Measure only these configured inputs, by name; the others, and the limits written against them, are left out.

outputJson.description: Write the JSON report. Off for a task that only gates limits and must not replace the full report.

outputMarkdown.description: Where to write the markdown badge block, relative to the project root.

title: Codometer
